entry.title: New: dsh-codegraph
entry.summary: DSH bundle that registers 13 native codegraph_* tools wrapping the codegraph CLI, so agents bootstrap, maintain, and query a pre-indexed code knowledge graph (symbol query, explore, node trail, callers/callees, impact, affected tests) instead of grepping files. Exact install spec: github:jiangzhenguo/dsh-codegraph. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
